correctness.rationale: The inspected exact checker reconstructs all 85 source line equations over \(\mathbf Q(\sqrt[4]2,\sqrt[4]3,i)\), tests every pair by a symbolic \(4\times4\) determinant, and obtains a 20-regular graph with 850 edges. Its integer adjacency arithmetic verifies the square-free annihilating polynomial \((z-20)(z-3)(z+1)(z+3)(z+5)(z+9)\) and traces \(85,0,1700,3180,210644,2821740\). Independently solving the resulting multiplicity equations reproduces \((1,46,6,16,10,6)\); shifting by \(-3\) gives rank 39 and inertia \((1,38,46)\). The common-neighbor census \(530\) edges with three common neighbors and \(320\) with none gives 530 triangles. The computation is exhaustive for all \(\binom{85}{2}\) line pairs and uses exact number-field arithmetic.
residual_risks: Completeness of the 85-line list is taken from Yu--Zhu's source theorem rather than reproved.
